title: Contingency Plan for Schools in Hot Weather Scenarios
what_it_is: Contingency Plan for Schools in Hot Weather Scenarios

sections.label: Heat measures in schools
sections.summary: Outdoor physical activities are minimised between 10.30 am and 3.30 pm, students are encouraged to drink water, and teachers watch vulnerable or unwell students.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: For example, outdoor physical activities are minimised between 10.30 am and 3.30 pm.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Students are encouraged to drink water before, during and after physical activities to prevent and alleviate exercise-induced heat strain.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Teachers watch out for students who are more vulnerable and those who appear unwell.

sections.label: Additional school heat measures
sections.summary: Schools may reduce activity duration or intensity, add rest and water breaks, allow PE attire or school T-shirts, update parents, and MOE aligns measures with Government advisories.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: When necessary, schools put in place additional measures, such as reducing the duration or intensity of the activities and ensuring more frequent rest and water breaks.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Schools may also explore ways to help students better manage the heat, such as allowing students to dress in physical education (PE) attire or their school T-shirt, depending on their specific needs.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Schools also keep parents updated on the measures taken.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: MOE works closely with the Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment, the National Environment Agency and the Ministry of Health and calibrates our management measures in alignment with the whole-of-Government plans and advisories.

sentences.speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
sentences.text: So, I am just wondering whether there is a consistency that is applied across all the schools so that, let us say, if I am a parent and I have got children in different schools, I do not get confused about what applies across them.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: But we leave it to the schools, depending on the way the conditions affect them at that point in time.
